text:
michelle: Hey friends — Omar and I hit our 5 year anniversary today! 🎉🥂 We're having a tiny backyard brunch this Saturday at 11am for anyone who wants to swing by. No gifts, just bring yourselves and bad wedding-dance stories :D
omar: so excited!! thanks for all the love already ❤️
ellie: omg congrats you two!! i'll be there, would love to help with setup :tada:
sam: i'll bring a mimosa kit (and a solid playlist) 🍾🎶
jordan: congrats!! what's the address? pm me
marco: croissants on me 🥐 can't wait
trisha: congrats! is it kid/pet friendly? asking for my niece (and dog)
michelle: backyard fenced, totally kid-friendly. i'll DM the address to folks who ask
people-ops-bot: :package: small anniversary gift on the way to Michelle & Omar — congrats from People Ops!
evan: sending love — will be out of town but hope it's a blast <3
michelle: aaand photos will be posted in #random after, fair warning for embarrassing dance moves :grin:
ellie: mandatory dance floor pics pls :camera_with_flash:
marco: RSVP ✅
jordan: RSVP ✅ (pm received)
sam: RSVP ✅ — adding '90s pop playlist
michelle: thanks y'all! truly means a lot. see some of you Saturday :) :heart:
(reactions: :tada: :heart: :party_parrot: )
